programmes.d: A Union major (Charlton Heston) chases Indians to Mexico with a condemned Confederate captain (Richard Harris) and a cavalry of prisoners.
Tim Barrett, a renowned lawman, rescues Patty from a ruffian and saves her brother from being lynched.
A peaceful man (Rock Hudson) hunts down the outlaw (Phil Carey) who has abducted his bride (Donna Reed).
A sheriff (Tim McCoy) flirts with a local girl (Marceline Day) and chases an outlaw called the Shadow.
An outlaw (Richard Boone) and his men hold an heiress (Maureen O'Sullivan), her cowardly husband and a rancher (Randolph Scott).
A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) loses his beloved in a robbery and hunts the man (George Macready) to blame, who is living off the loot.
On a cattle drive to Kansas after the Civil War, an ex-Union soldier comes up against Apache and Confederate renegades.
Two old-time Wyoming fur trappers (Charlton Heston, Brian Keith) try to protect a runaway Indian (Victoria Racimo) from her angry ex-mate.
An Indian sympathizer accused of running guns to the Arapaho is court-martialed by the man who framed him.
A Confederate colonel (Richard Widmark) makes a cattleman (William Holden) teach his troops how to herd Union cattle.
Old West outlaw Bill Doolin (Randolph Scott) marries a deacon's wife, but his gang will not leave him alone.
An Army lieutenant (George Montgomery) is ordered to go after Florida Indians in Texas.
Settlers and a sheriff catch on to a Chicago swindler's land scam.
A former Texas Ranger's plans to marry are complicated by his future brother-in-law's involvement with cattle rustlers.
A cavalry major (George Montgomery) makes peace with Indians despite an agitator (Richard Denning) working for carpetbaggers.
Three brothers become outlaws after the Civil War, while a fourth sibling goes to work for the railroad.
